app.title: National AI Workforce Reskilling & Foresight Engine
app.subtitle: Malaysia 2026–2030 Smart Workforce Strategy & SDG Alignment
app.disclaimer_legal: Official Decision Support Engine. In compliance with Malaysia Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) 2010. Purely advisory — does not perform autonomous employment decisions.
app.footer: © 2026 National Workforce Foresight Initiative. Grounded on MASCO 2020, ILO 2025, and UN SDG Framework.

overview.heading: Strategic Workforce Foresight Architecture
overview.intro: The Malaysian National Workforce Foresight Engine synchronizes occupational taxonomy (MASCO 2020), longitudinal labour market signals, and macroeconomic stress-testing into individualized learner roadmaps and privacy-preserving enterprise aggregation.
overview.architecture_desc: Built on 6 Core Engines (M1–M6) and 6 Operational Services (O1–O6), maintaining strict cryptographic freezing, zero demographic leakage, and human-in-the-loop sovereignty.

radar.heading: Longitudinal Skills Demand & Velocity Radar
radar.description: Signals synthesized from job vacancy postings, wage premiums, research emergence, and international labour classifications (ILO 2025).

matching.heading: Multi-Criteria Career Matching
matching.description: Evaluates candidate occupational pathways combining skill overlap, trajectory viability, macro resilience, and transition feasibility.

gaps.heading: Diagnostic Skill Gap Breakdown
gaps.description: Decomposes role requirements into discrete competencies, categorizing deficits into Core, Important, and Supporting tiers.

pathway.heading: Personalised Sovereign Reskilling Pathway
pathway.description: Dependency-aware curriculum sequenced for working adults, calibrated at sustainable pacing of 5–8 hours per calendar week.
pathway.sovereignty_notice: Learner Sovereignty: You maintain full agency over learning order and pace. Automated recommendations serve as advisory guidelines.

scenarios.heading: Macroeconomic Scenario Stress-Testing
scenarios.description: Simulates structural labor shifts under national policy directions and external global shocks.

sdg.heading: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Contribution
sdg.description: Maps workforce competencies and transition roadmaps to SDG Targets with explicit causal relationship types.
sdg.primary_goals: Targeted SDGs: Decent Work (SDG 8), Industry & Innovation (SDG 9), Quality Education (SDG 4), Climate Action (SDG 13)

replanning.heading: Adaptive Replanning & Change Governance
replanning.banner_desc: Upstream market signals have shifted since your last plan confirmation.
replanning.acknowledge_prompt: Review proposed adjustments before promoting candidate roadmap to active state.

employer.heading: Employer Workforce Diagnostics & Cohort Reskilling
employer.description: Enterprise-level gap intelligence with strict k-anonymity (k=5) small-cell masking and zero individual surveillance.
employer.privacy_banner: Small-Cell Privacy Active: All cohort cells under 5 profiles are strictly suppressed (<5) to defeat deduction attacks.
employer.disclaimer_hr: Strict HR Guardrail: Aggregate planning metrics must never be utilized for hiring, termination, performance evaluation, or individual salary determination.

progress.heading: Milestone & Skill Evidence Tracker
progress.description: Track modular progression, upload credential verification references, and update verified capability portfolios.
progress.disclaimer_employment: Official Notice: Completion of learning modules demonstrates training engagement and capability acquisition. It does not constitute an automated guarantee of employment or wage elevation.

governance.heading: Responsible AI Architecture & Invariance Auditing
governance.demographic_neutrality: Demographic Invariance: System architecture completely excludes gender, race, religion, age, and disability. Validated via counterfactual invariance testing.
governance.privacy_compliance: Privacy Assurance: Compliant with Malaysia Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) 2010. Synthetic persona testbeds ensure zero personal record exposure.
governance.auditability: Cryptographic Auditability: Every engine release is bound by SHA-256 frozen manifests with immutable provenance records.

low_bandwidth.savings_summary: Data transfer optimized: ~75% reduction via stripped vectors, compressed tables, and lightweight typography.
low_bandwidth.offline_ready: Lightweight representation ready for constrained edge networks.
